title: Alternative Chat
description: Create an alternative way of sending chat message
body:
This datapack offers a way of talking in the chat without having to access it directly.

## How to :
> Take a **Book & Quill** (writable_book) and write whatever you want to send in chat.

>> Then "**Sign**" it and name it "**/chat**" for it to be detected by the datapack.

>>> Then click on it to read it (/!\ **IN YOUR MAIN HAND** /!\), it will then clear your main hand and send the message in the chat with your name.
